name: Ayceezee
description: Ayceezee was an inhabited world in the galaxy with rolling walkways and a university as of 44 ABY. Former Wraith Squadron member Voort saBinring retired there as a mathematics professor until re-recruited by Garik Loran in 44 ABY.
